# Documentation Instructions

- Keep AGENTS.md and docs/ai as canonical references.
- Avoid policy duplication across tool-specific files.
- Keep writing concise, deterministic, and unambiguous.
- Update docs when workflow, architecture, or experiment protocol changes.
- Preserve consistency with docs/ai/repository-conventions.md.
